page.heading: Skills

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create one here, or import a Markdown file or .zip archive.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

page.subtitle: Reusable rule blocks. Attach them to an agent and they become part of its prompt.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: The body is stored as text and becomes part of an agent’s prompt once you enable it.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

listItem.vettingTitle: Came from outside — read the body before enabling it

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from outside. Its body is added to an agent’s prompt as instructions the model will follow — read it before you enable it.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

create.title: Create a skill
create.subtitle: A skill is configuration text. It is appended to the prompt of every agent you attach it to.
create.name: Name
create.descriptionHint: Phrase it as a directive — this is what tells an agent when the skill applies. "Flag a test that covers only the happy path", not "about test coverage".
create.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag a test that exercises only one side of a branch.
create.bodyHint: The block appended to the prompt, under a "### Skill: <name>" header.
create.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule

Describe what to flag, and what not to flag.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: Upload a Markdown file or a .zip archive. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.chooseHint: Accepts .md or .zip. Only the markdown is read — scripts and binaries in an archive are listed, never run.
import.ignoredCount: {count, plural, one {# other entry} other {# other entries}}
import.trustBody: A skill body is added to an agent’s prompt as instructions it will follow. This one will be saved disabled — read it, then enable it yourself if you trust it.
import.success: Imported "{name}". It is disabled until you enable it.

editor.name: Name
editor.descriptionHint: Phrase it as a directive — this is what tells an agent when the skill applies.
editor.bodyHint: Any change to name, description, type or body is saved as a new version. Turning the skill on or off is not.
editor.deleteConfirm: Delete the skill "{name}"? It will be removed from every agent using it.
editor.usedBy: Attach it to an agent from that agent’s Skills tab.

card.agents: {count, plural, =0 {No agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}
card.statsTitle: Last {days} days: share of review runs that used this skill, and how its findings were triaged.

previewTab.prompt: As it appears in the prompt
previewTab.promptHint: Exactly the block appended under "## Skills / rules" for every agent this skill is attached to and enabled on.

stats.linkedEmpty: Not attached to any agent yet. Attach it from an agent’s Skills tab.
stats.findingsTitle: Findings from runs that used it
stats.noData: No review has used this skill in the last {days} days, so there is nothing to measure yet.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every content edit — name, description, type or body — is saved as a new version. Restoring an old one adds it back as the newest version, so nothing is ever lost.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? Its content becomes a new version v{next}; nothing is deleted.
